title: Can ChatGPT Reproduce Human-Generated Labels? A Study of Social Computing Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot annotation performance and F1-score disparities between 'Pro-Russia' and 'Pro-Ukraine' stances using a Russo-Ukrainian conflict Twitter dataset, identifying a strong model tendency to misclassify pro-Ukraine tweets as pro-Russia.
Assessing the model's accuracy and precision in identifying anti-Asian hate speech versus counterspeech and neutral text using the COVID-HATE dataset.

Analyzing classification confusion matrices across five tasks to identify systematic algorithmic tendencies, such as overestimating 'Neutral' labels in sentiment analysis and defaulting to 'Human' over 'Bot' in deepfake detection.
